metadata.title: MEDAS Planet Nine search: production run p9prod-9a084ed (N-body, 64,000 test bodies, 0-4 Gyr), data and evaluation
metadata.description:
N-body run of the Planet Nine of the posterior of Brown & Batygin (2021) with 64,000 massless test bodies over 0-4 Gyr (p9gpu v5, Wisdom-Holman with smooth close-encounter sub-steps, FP64), with its evaluation (clustering measures M1-M5 over 1-4 Gyr). Criteria, tools and packages were fixed before the run and notarised on the chain medasdigital-2 (entries a3, e2, e3, e4, e5; this record is fixed by entry e6, transaction , block ). sha256 of MANIFEST.sha256: .

Model and limits: gravity of the Sun and the giant planets and Planet Nine only; massless test bodies; no galactic tide, no passing stars; no observational bias. Not peer-reviewed.

Verification: (1) sha256 of MANIFEST.sha256 equals the content of entry e6; (2) every file equals MANIFEST.sha256; (3) one segment rerun with the package gives its result hash (README).
